steps.clue: Restore power, sync the Glocke Drop Controller and call in Pack-a-Punch.
Collect the Chain Links, Chilly Chunks and Lantern, then restore Astrid in the Burial Grounds.
Follow Astrid to the lighthouse and obtain the Jotunn Star.
Use the Crowbar and Flak Round to recover the Transmitter and install it in Tyr’s Head.
Decode Tyr’s blinking lights to obtain the Wunderbarrage Controller.
Collect the three Uranium Canisters and assemble the Atomkraft Core.
Charge the Atomkraft Core and deliver it to Storm Bridge to obtain the Dravakar Shard.
Cook the Dravakar Shard with the Jotunn Star and a Disciple Injection to obtain the Sunstone.
Use the Sunstone to reveal and ignite the three rune-marked bonfires in order.
Enter Tyr’s Head and defeat Dravakar.
